title: Phyllis’ Wedding
one_paragraph_synopsis: Phyllis gets married to Bob Vance in a ceremony filled with humorous and heartfelt moments involving her coworkers. Michael is included in the wedding party primarily to secure time off, and he awkwardly supports Phyllis throughout the day. A surprising moment occurs when Phyllis' father, Albert, unexpectedly stands up from his wheelchair and walks down the aisle, delighting everyone. Meanwhile, Dwight exhibits his usual officiousness by demanding wedding details and removing an uninvited guest. The episode also explores interactions among other characters, including Kelly's sympathy for Pam and a conversation between Roy and Pam about their past.

main_threads.thread: Phyllis' wedding ceremony and the surprising recovery of her father Albert.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Phyllis is getting married. And I am in the wedding party. She has asked me to push her father's wheelchair down the aisle.
Albert gets out of his wheelchair and starts walking
Dwight: It's a miracle.

Priest: And do you, Phyllis, take Bob Vance, Vance Refrigeration, to be your lawfully wedded husband?
Phyllis: I do.
Michael: Ladies and Gentlemen, may I present to you for the first time as a couple, Mr. and Mrs. Bob Vance!

main_threads.thread: Michael's involvement in the wedding party and his awkward attempts to help Phyllis.

evidence.snippet: Phyllis: Yes, I put Michael in my wedding. It was the only way I could think to get six weeks off for my honeymoon.

Michael: Phyllis! Are you happy with everything? What can I do to make it more perfecter?
Phyllis: Thank you, Michael.

main_threads.thread: Dwight's insistence on wedding details and his removal of an uninvited guest.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Best of luck, Phyllis. Also I'm going to need to see a copy of the guest manifest as well as photographs of the caterers.

Dwight: 'Scuse me, sir. How do you know the happy couple?
Dwight: Got to find yourself another wedding to crash, my friend.
